newsitem.title: USA: Craig Electronics named in lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Craig Electronics named in lawsuit.

text.p: Craig Consumer Electronics Inc was named in a shareholder lawsuit filed on behalf of investors who bought the stock between May 21, 1996 and March 10, 1997, a law firm said.

The case, which was filed in U.S. District Court for the Central District of California, claims that the company misrepresented or omitted material information about the company's financial position, Goodkind Labaton Rudoff & Sucharow LLP, the law firm said.
The company said on March 10 that it would restate its 1995 earnings lower due to certain adjustments and accounting irregularities.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
